results.title: 太上正一盟威朝仪
results.issue: No independent text of this exact title in Zhengtong Daozang; related 正一朝仪/盟威 materials appear only in ordination/liturgy strata. Claim is cautious and catalog-aligned but cannot be fully confirmed as a named standalone work.

results.title: 太上说豁落七元经
results.issue: Standard Daozang title is usually 北帝说豁落七元经 (or close variants), not 太上说… Exact title form is slightly off; content description (Beidi, Qiyuan talismans, Beidou, lamps, memorials) is broadly correct.

results.title: 灵宝施食科仪
results.issue: Closest Zhengtong/Xu Daozang match is often cited as 灵宝施食法 rather than this exact title; ritual outline is plausible but title and ‘nearest’ identification are approximate.

results.title: 历世真仙体道通鉴后编
results.issue: Main series is 正编 (DZ296), 续编 (DZ297), 后集 (DZ298); ‘后编’ is not the standard catalog title. Content note on female immortals in 后集 is broadly right, but naming is imprecise.

results.title: 太清阴阳五行经
results.issue: No secure Zhengtong Daozang / Schipper–Verellen hit for this exact title; ‘lost, misnamed, or scattered Taiqing/wuxing material’ is a reasonable non-claim rather than a false positive.

results.title: 黄帝太一八门逆顺生死诀
results.issue: A short Dongxuan/shuzhong-style Taiyi Eight Gates text with mixed arts and a later Taiyin Xuannü section is attested in catalogs, but exact DZ number, division, and structure details need tighter source pinning.

results.title: 上清太极隐注玉经宝诀
results.issue: Known ancient Lingbao (though Shangqing-titled) work on scripture reception/recitation is real; ‘one juan + full ritual inventory’ is directionally right but depends on which recension is meant.

results.title: 太上灵宝胞胎经
results.issue: Exact title not securely verified in Zhengtong Daozang; embryo/birth themes exist elsewhere in early Lingbao, but identity with this name remains unproven.

results.title: 太上说消魔经
results.issue: No single short-title text; nearest are multiple xiaomo scriptures (e.g. 洞真太上说智慧消魔真经). Correct as a title-cluster note, not a unique work.

results.title: 太上说西王母益算经
results.issue: Exact title not confirmed in Zhengtong Daozang; Xiwangmu / yisuan longevity themes exist in other works, so absence claim is fair but negative evidence is incomplete.

results.title: 谷神篇
results.issue: Yuan neidan work by Lin Yuan (Xuanchaozi), two juan, is standard; Dongzhen fangfa placement and doctrinal summary are broadly right, but finer catalog claims were not exhaustively rechecked against Schipper numbers.

results.title: 还丹众仙论
results.issue: Yang Zai / ca. 1052 one-juan compilation of many masters is widely accepted; list of names and section placement are plausible but some master attributions in the blurb may be traditional rather than critically verified.

results.title: 老子节解
results.issue: Attributed to Ge Xuan in bibliographic tradition (e.g. Songshi entry); no complete Zhengtong Daozang text. Transmission and modern Yan Lingfeng reconstitutions are correctly flagged as uncertain.

results.title: 灵棋经
results.issue: Identity with 灵棋本章正经, two juan, 124-ish hexagram-style casts is correct; authorship as Eastern Jin monk Fǎwèi (per Yu Jiaxi) vs. later Yan/He commentary chain is debated scholarship, so ‘author = Fǎwèi’ is stronger than fully settled.

results.title: 三洞众戒文
results.issue: Zhang Wanfu compilation of Three Caverns precept texts is real; original two juan / Daozang amalgamation and the long list of precept sets are broadly right but item-by-item inventory may be incomplete or reorder-simplified.

results.title: 太清玉炉经
results.issue: No confirmed Zhengtong Daozang text under this exact title in common digital catalogs; cautious ‘unverified / possibly non-canonical’ stance is appropriate, not a positive false identification.

results.title: 上清丹元玉经
results.issue: Closest match is usually 上清丹元玉真帝皇飞仙上经 (often DZ404 in Schipper/Komjathy numbering). User short title is approximate; Dongxuan yujue vs Dongzhen labeling correction is the main partial point.

results.title: 太上说洪恩灵济真君妙经
results.issue: Canonical full title is typically 灵宝天尊说洪恩灵济真君妙经; Yongle imperial preface and Xu brothers / Hong’en Lingji cult are correct. Short title ‘太上说…’ is a near-title, not the exact catalog form.

results.title: 太上说十一曜大消灾神咒经
results.issue: Standard title is 元始天尊说十一曜大消灾神咒经; content on eleven luminaries is right. Short ‘太上说…’ form is a common near-title, not the catalog lemma.

results.title: 道德真经取善集
results.issue: Li Lin’s 取善 anthology is real; Dongshen yujue (not Taiqing) placement is the important correction already stated. Commentator roster is selective, not exhaustive.

results.title: 太上老君说牛王妙经
results.issue: Folk Niuwang scripture, mainly shanshu/local print, not confirmed in Zhengtong Daozang catalogs—fair negative claim; ‘sometimes with Mazu’ is regionally variable and not a fixed feature.

results.title: 太上三十六部尊经
results.issue: Six juan, 36 short scriptures in three pure realms × 12, Buddhist–Daoist hybrid language is standard; exact Daozang numbering (‘提要号 8’) and doctrinal summary are slightly simplified.

results.title: 上清九真中经（上清太上帝君九真中经）
results.issue: Early Shangqing Nine Perfected visualization text is correctly identified; full alternate title and methods (nine palaces, five viscera, solar-lunar ‘奔’ techniques) are right in outline, details truncated/partial.

results.title: 太上灵宝十部经
results.issue: Correct that this is a collective label for the early Lingbao corpus (ten sections / multi-juan set), not a single independent Zhengtong entry under that exact short title.
